## Dell Pricing Updates

Dell pricing is highly negotiable across endpoints, servers, storage, support, financing, and lifecycle services.

## Key Price Changes
- Client devices: Discounts improve through standardized SKUs and volume commitments
- Servers/storage: Discounts depend on configuration, support term, and competitive pressure
- Support services: ProSupport and warranty terms can materially increase total cost

## Business Impact
- Bundling endpoints and infrastructure can increase negotiation leverage
- Storage renewals can create lock-in if migration paths are unclear
- AI server capacity may command premium pricing due to GPU supply and demand

## What This Means
- Run competitive bids for major infrastructure refreshes
- Negotiate support renewals and hardware discounts together
- Define AI workload requirements before buying premium GPU infrastructure
